subject: Strip LTO flags from static Lua module build (#3555)
reason: The change is build-system only: it strips LTO flags (-flto, -flto=auto, -ffat-lto-objects) from the static Lua module Makefile so that archiving into libvalkeylua.a does not produce LTO bitcode objects the system linker cannot read. No runtime behaviour, command reply, replication, persistence or protocol path changes; the fuzzer compiling the build already exercises the only affected path (linking), so no scenario is needed.
